To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a graph-based method can enable agile MDAO by providing a flexible way to specify and integrate complex MDAO systems.

KADMOS enables agile MDAO through the following contributions: 1) the use of a graph-based approach to formulate the MDAO system, 2) the use of two data models to store and exchange information about the MDAO system and the product being designed, 3) the integration of the generated MDAO formulation as an executable process workflow, and 4) the use of dynamic visualizations of the MDAO graph to enable human oversight and control.

KADMOS can (1) automatically generate the formal specification of an arbitrary MDAO system; (2) generate the formal representation of the MDAO workflow in a way that it can be used in a wide range of process integration and design automation tools; and (3) enable the collaborative design of large MDAO systems in the aerospace domain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the formulation and integration of MDO systems for collaborative design.
the formulation of a computational system that is required to enable collaborative MDAO, and the implementation of a software tool, KADMOS, which can automate this formulation process.
the development of a methodology and its implementation to increase the agility in collaborative design of complex products.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work presents a novel methodological approach to enable the agile integration and iterative reconfiguration of large-scale MDAO systems in the collaborative context of aircraft design.
KADMOS enables a more agile, efficient, and collaborative design process.
the proposed approach has been shown to be a valuable addition to current MDAO practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
KADMOS enables a collaborative, agile and transparent approach to MDAO.
